answer: Randomised submission windows at the garden of epochs: each identity must submit within an unpredictable 30s slot, so a farmer cannot batch-mine. The wharf of pending txs enforces temporal spread—correlating 1,000 identities into one window costs 1,000 distinct timing signatures. Attackers pay ~$0.40 per slot of jitter, ~$400 total, plus orphan risk. The horizon of honest miners stays wide; sybils cluster and get slashed. Why it works: randomness converts cheap parallel farming into costly serial scheduling.
